invariants.rationale: Method behavior depends on iterating over 'orders', so it must be non-null at exit.
The method throws if a null order is encountered; at exit, all orders must be non-null.
The method throws on any non-positive quantity, so all orders must have positive quantity.
The method throws if any order has a negative unit price; all must be zero or positive.
Combined check: all orders are non-null with positive quantity and non-negative unit price.
